response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial credentials (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS, FOSS4G talk) and some low-latency, high-throughput systems work at Sociomantic using D with async I/O, fibers, and caching. However, the role's core requirement is modern C++ (or Rust) systems development, and his only C/C++ exposure is a six-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis project; C++ does not appear in his stated skill set. The last decade has been predominantly TypeScript/Node.js/D full-stack and product work, with no navigation guidance, routing tile, or large-scale data pipeline experience. He could plausibly ramp into the role given his systems background and demonstrated willingness to learn new stacks, but he would be a stretch hire against candidates with current production C++ and navigation-domain experience.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS product experience, including an open-source mapping platform
Low-latency, high-throughput microservices work with async I/O and caching at Sociomantic
Proven adaptability across languages, platforms, and full stack, with strong testing/TDD discipline
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and roughly a decade stale; no Rust at all
No navigation guidance, routing, or map-tiling pipeline background
Recent roles are web/product-focused (TypeScript/Node), not systems or data-pipeline engineering
